checked.claim: Totality (cw8 v003-N1, A282), with Claude3's own probe totality_probe_c3.py b2d5f835. It covers 1008 synthetic honest FAILED-class receipts: 3 lanes (DDO; NGC without and with post-seal attestation) x 3 driver statuses (FAILED, FAILED_AT_STAGE, ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT) x 7 outcomes x 4 stage layouts x 2 exits x finish present/absent. Every receipt returns a row, and none raises. Every row passes the roster builder's cause-binding checks (receipt, spec and driver bound; status equal; result bound when present). Only ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT with ITERATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or CONVERGED_FINITE_FIXED_POINT is counted. Absent, None, unknown and NONCONVERGENCE are uncounted with ROUTE_A_OUTCOME_MISSING_OR_UNKNOWN. The same probe on cxv002 counted 12 such rows, so the fix is effective.
checked.label: TESTED

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: CONVERGED_FINITE_FIXED_POINT under ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT is counted, but honest producers cannot emit it
findings.evidence: The solvers return that outcome only with converged_finite_fixed_point True (fixedsrc L210, uvtail L239, parallel uvtail L356). The driver raises RouteANoFixedPoint only when classification is ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT, i.e. conv_flag is not True (r5 L1913-1915, L1961-1964). Only forged or inconsistent metadata could pair them (A115 NOTE). Codex2's positive fixture real_iterator_outcome_CONVERGED_FINITE_FIXED_POINT exercises that unreachable pair. A later version could treat the pair as inconsistent and uncounted.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: A missing checkpoint outcome stays uncounted, as root ruled (0848)
findings.evidence: route_a_outcome.outcome is None only if the solver ran without a checkpoint (fixedsrc L108). The r5 route-A inputs always include checkpoint_directory (L3960), so honest production runs carry an outcome.

disposition: review PASS, ready for root adoption (0851 item 5)
